steps.text: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil.
Whisk the eggs, yolk, and pecorino into a paste. Season with black pepper.
Crisp the guanciale in a cold, dry pan over medium heat until golden.
Add spaghetti to the boiling water and cook until al dente.
Reserve a cup of pasta water, then drain the spaghetti.
Toss the hot pasta with the guanciale off the heat.
Stir in the egg mixture, loosening with pasta water until silky. Do NOT scramble.
Plate, top with more pecorino and pepper, and serve immediately.
